authorities.name: Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan
authorities.mandate: Corporate incorporation, corporate filings, single member company regulation, and director accountability.

authorities.name: Federal Board of Revenue
authorities.mandate: National Tax Number (NTN) registration, Active Taxpayer List (ATL), federal sales tax on goods, and withholding tax management.

authorities.name: Pakistan Software Export Board
authorities.primary_statute: Income Tax Ordinance 2001 (Section 154A) & PSEB Policy Guidelines
authorities.mandate: Facilitation of IT & ITeS exporters, IT freelancer registration, and certification for 0.25% concessionary export tax credit.

authorities.name: Punjab Revenue Authority
authorities.primary_statute: Punjab Sales Tax on Services Act 2012
authorities.mandate: Levy and collection of provincial sales tax on services (16% standard, reduced rates on IT) rendered in Punjab.

authorities.name: Sindh Revenue Board
authorities.primary_statute: Sindh Sales Tax on Services Act 2011
authorities.mandate: Levy and collection of provincial sales tax on services (13% standard, 3% on IT) rendered in Sindh.

key_compliance_deadlines.consequence_of_delay: Removal from Active Taxpayer List (ATL), leading to 100% higher withholding tax deductions on banking and business transactions.

key_compliance_deadlines.event: Annual Income Tax Return (Companies / Pvt Ltd)
key_compliance_deadlines.statutory_deadline: December 31 each year (for tax year ending June 30)
key_compliance_deadlines.consequence_of_delay: Financial penalties under Section 182 and suspension of tax certificates.
Penalties for non-filing of withholding tax statements under Section 165.

key_compliance_deadlines.statutory_deadline: Minimum 6 years from end of tax year
key_compliance_deadlines.consequence_of_delay: Disallowance of business expense deductions under audit (Section 174).
